# Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3

Pinned Leaflet clustering extension, lazy-loaded only with map view. Custom cluster icons count distinct offerings, rather than recurring event records.

- https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/leaflet.markercluster.js
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/MarkerCluster.css
- https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster/blob/v1.5.3/MIT-LICENCE.txt

MIT license bundled as LICENSE. Uses the site stylesheet for cluster colors.
